titleEn: Farmers to gain control with John Deere AI assistant data tool
titleZh: 约翰迪尔AI助手JD赋予农民数据掌控力
summaryZh: 约翰迪尔在2026年Farm Progress展会上推出内置AI助手"JD"，集成于Operations Center平台，让农民通过自然对话方式查询和分析农机与田间数据。该工具可回答燃油使用对比、播种均匀度对产量的影响、收割最佳时机等问题。公司同时强调"农民数据承诺"，确保数据控制权归属农民，不售卖数据，并计划后续扩展至草坪、建筑、林业等领域。
featuredReason: 约翰迪尔将生成式AI对话能力引入农业数据管理，代表了农机数据智能化应用的前沿方向，对智慧畜牧与精准农业从业者理解未来数据工具演进具有重要参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Farmers to gain control with John Deere AI assistant data tool ![Image 1: Joshua Kelly By Joshua Kelly September 4, 2026 6:00 PM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthorjoshua-kelly) Share this article ![Image 2: Source: John Deere](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsfarmers-to-gain-control-with-john-deere-ai-assistant-data-tool) Source: John Deere John Deere has shown off its new artificial intelligence (AI) assistant called JD that aims to simplify data processing on farms. The American company is updating its 'John Deere Operations Centre' farm management platform with JD, an AI assistant built into the system that the company says "gives farmers an entirely new way to put their data to work". According to John Deere, farmers can ask the AI a question and it will generate results based on data collected in the tractor. Response generation The AI "enables farmers to have a conversation with the vast amount of field, machine and operational data they generate", the company said. Its is to "create the opportunity" to improve yields, drive savings and strengthen farm profitability. Instead of searching across dashboards and reports, farmers can ask a multitude of questions, such as: How did my fuel use during tillage this year compare with the last three years? How did singulation compare across my fields, and what impact did it have on yield? Which sprayer operator is covering the most acres per hour? When is the optimal time to harvest based on historical trends? According to John Deere, with JD, farmers can "surface the right information quickly and receive practical responses grounded in their own data". John Deere chief technology officer, Jahmy Hindman, spoke about the role JD can play in improving data analysis on farms. He said: "Farmers have more data available to them than ever before, but the value comes from their ability to use it in the moments that matter. "JD changes the experience from navigating through a sea of data to simply asking it a question. "It puts advanced data analysis within reach by enabling farmers to receive answers tailored to their farm and their needs in a matter of seconds." Data processing John Deere says that farmers should remain in control of their data, understand how it is used and receive clear value from it. The company claims its Farmer Data Commitment reinforces that approach with 10 principles, including that the farmer controls their data, the company does not sell data and only uses it as described in agreements and policies. John Deere has committed to raising awareness of any changes to data usage in the future before they take place. It said any data it uses is anonymised and aimed at developing "improved machine performance and decision-making insights". ![Image 3: Source: John Deere](https:images.agriland.iedFIjRV5111ShHN5PqxcsFGi2KXvxVmRICthEsH2IXUrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202606sport-packageplus-scaled.jpg) Source: John Deere Farmers can choose not to share farm data with third parties, and can also choose which third parties they want to share data with. John Deere says it will not use farm data for agricultural commodity trading or speculation, and that farmers will receive clear value from their farm data. Deanna Kovar, who leads John Deere's agriculture division, spoke about the company's commitment to putting farmers in control of their data. She said: "Farmers receive value from their data when they can use it to make better decisions, and we believe that value should come with control, transparency and choice. "Our view is simple: farmers should control their data, clearly understand how it is used, and benefit from the insights it can create. "JD and the Farmer Data Commitment are part of the same vision for helping farmers put their data to work on their terms," she said. JD John Deere is also opening a limited early access programme for select agricultural customers in the US, allowing eligible participants to express interest in participation. The AI assistant will become more broadly available later this year through Operations Centre on web, mobile, and eventually via in-cab display interface. John Deere said it plans to introduce capabilities tailored to customers across turf, construction, roadbuilding and forestry, extending JD's value across the company's broader customer base. JD was on display at the 2026 Farm Progress show, where attendees could learn about the AI and hear about the company's approach to both data and AI usage. While JD is set to come to Ireland and the UK together, a timeframe has not been announced as to when that will be. translationZh:
约翰迪尔展示了其名为JD的新型人工智能（AI）助手，旨在简化农场数据处理流程。这家美国公司正在其"约翰迪尔运营中心"农场管理平台中集成JD，这是一款内置于系统中的AI助手，该公司称其"为农民提供了一种利用数据的全新方式"。据约翰迪尔介绍，农民可以向AI提问，系统将根据拖拉机中收集的数据生成结果。

**响应生成**

该AI"使农民能够与其产生的大量田间、机械和运营数据进行对话"，该公司表示。其目标是"创造机会"以提高产量、节省成本并增强农场盈利能力。农民无需在仪表盘和报告中搜索，即可提出多种问题，例如：今年耕作期间的燃油使用量与过去三年相比如何？各田块间的播种均匀度表现如何，对产量有何影响？哪位喷药机操作员每小时作业面积最大？基于历史趋势，何时是收获的最佳时机？

据约翰迪尔称，借助JD，农民可以"快速获取正确的信息，并收到基于自身数据的实用回答"。

约翰迪尔首席技术官Jahmy Hindman谈到了JD在改善农场数据分析方面可以发挥的作用。他表示："农民拥有的数据比以往任何时候都多，但其价值在于他们能否在关键时刻加以利用。JD将体验从在数据海洋中导航转变为直接提问。它使先进的数据分析触手可及，让农民能够在几秒钟内获得针对其农场和需求量身定制的答案。"

**数据处理**

约翰迪尔表示，农民应保持对其数据的控制权，了解数据的使用方式，并从中获得明确价值。该公司声称其"农民数据承诺"通过10项原则强化了这一方针，包括农民控制其数据、公司不出售数据、仅按协议和政策中的描述使用数据。约翰迪尔承诺在未来数据使用方式发生任何变化之前提前告知。该公司表示，其使用的任何数据均经过匿名化处理，旨在开发"改进的机器性能和决策洞察"。

农民可以选择不与第三方共享农场数据，也可以选择与哪些第三方共享数据。约翰迪尔表示不会将农场数据用于农产品大宗商品交易或投机，并称农民将从其农场数据中获得明确价值。

负责约翰迪尔农业部门的Deanna Kovar谈到了公司致力于让农民掌控自身数据的承诺。她表示："当农民能够利用数据做出更好的决策时，他们就从数据中获得了价值，我们相信这种价值应伴随着控制权、透明度和选择权。我们的观点很简单：农民应控制自己的数据，清楚了解其使用方式，并受益于数据所能创造的洞察。JD和'农民数据承诺'是同一愿景的一部分，即帮助农民按照自己的方式利用数据。"

**JD**

约翰迪尔还正在为美国部分精选农业客户开放有限早期访问计划，允许符合条件的参与者表达参与意向。该AI助手将于今年晚些时候通过运营中心在网页端和移动端更广泛地推出，最终还将通过驾驶室内显示界面提供。

约翰迪尔表示，计划为草坪、建筑、道路建设和林业领域的客户引入定制功能，将JD的价值扩展到公司更广泛的客户群。

JD在2026年Farm Progress展会上进行了展示，参观者可以了解该AI并听取公司对数据和AI使用方式的介绍。

虽然JD将同时登陆爱尔兰和英国，但尚未公布具体时间表。
